column1: # The counts tools/kx_check.py measures over the rule cells, each with the maximum it may reach. A count above its
# maximum refuses the check; each number only falls. A cell is counted once per distinct (grammar, family, text).

column3: a cell orders rows by a signed instant (most through the fold default pick=…max(asserted_at)…)
a cell orders rows by a digest or a key id (the fold default ends …min(attestation_id))
a cell compares the signed instants of two different rows (at asserted_at, boundary(asserted_at), @signed, counted_at=signed)
a cell reads when this node first held a row, outside a clock or an expiry (order=…min(admission_order))
mean, median, rate or / in a cell: read here as integers (floor of the mean, lower median, table weight, floor division)
a reaction names fold(NAME) and no cell defines that fold
refuse on a guard clause or a change whose computed layer is not the door (it reads another row)
a fold counts a set @decision or @count: the set its own outcome changes
a member a cell reads has no row in formal/derivation/kx_field_types.tsv
a cell that does not parse or does not translate
a cell uses a word this translation does not carry (DROPPED in tools/kx_translate.py), or a policy_text cell not yet translated: not counted as translated
two words of one closed class that the translation reads alike, neither declared dropped
a fold cell states by=, result= or feeds=: carried to the manifest, not evaluated
seeded one-operator mutants of guard translations that no generated row set tells apart
